title: Supercell construction
action: Construct 1×1×1 supercells of cubic NiTi2 and Ni2Ti4Ox (x=0.25,0.5,0.75,1) in the Fd-3m space group. Place oxygen atoms at the tetrahedral sites according to the occupancy needed for each composition. Also prepare reference structures for elemental Ni (fcc), Ti (hcp), and O (O₂ molecule) in their standard states.
description: Atomic structure preparation for DFT inputs.

title: DFT total energy calculations
action: Perform geometry optimization and total energy calculations for all constructed supercells and elemental references using the GGA-PBE functional. Set a plane-wave cutoff energy of 380 eV and a total-energy convergence of at least 5×10⁻⁷ eV/atom. Obtain the relaxed total energies for NiTi2, Ni2Ti4O0.25, Ni2Ti4O0.5, Ni2Ti4O0.75, Ni2Ti4O, and the elemental references.
description: DFT total energies that serve as input for the formation enthalpy derivation.

title: Formation enthalpy derivation
action: Apply the formation enthalpy formulas to the DFT total energies obtained in Step 2. Compute the formation enthalpy per formula unit in kJ/mol for NiTi2 and for each Ni2Ti4Ox composition (x = 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1). Write the results to a CSV file.
description: Formation enthalpies in kJ/mol for NiTi2 and Ni2Ti4Ox compounds. The verifier checks the reported values against reference data within a tolerance and verifies the monotonic trend with oxygen content.
output_schema: Columns: compound (string), num_O (integer), formation_enthalpy_kJ_per_mol (float). Rows: NiTi2 (num_O=0), Ni2Ti4O0.25 (4), Ni2Ti4O0.5 (8), Ni2Ti4O0.75 (12), Ni2Ti4O (16).
